title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Why Autronica?

At Autronica, you're joining a leading innovator, supplier, and system integrator of fire and gas safety solutions worldwide. Our products protect lives and assets on land, at sea, and in the energy sectors. We are an international company with offices across the globe, and our HQ is located in Trondheim, Norway's technology hotspot. Autronica's greatest assets are the expertise, creativity, and passion of our employees – and we're excited for you to join the team.

Do you want to be part of a highly committed team striving toward our vision of zero loss of lives, no injuries, or damages caused by fire and gas ?

About the role

Autronica is seeking a Regional Sales Manager for Energy sector to grow the company's Fire and Security solutions across the South America. In this role you will engage directly with clients, EPCs, system integrators, MEP, and other industrial land contractors, driving project wins and expanding Autronica's presence in the region. The role covers FPSO, LNG, Clean Energy, and conventional energy projects across upstream, midstream, and downstream segments, as well as emerging markets such as Renewables.

Reporting to the Regional Sales Director, you will work to ensure alignment, sustainable growth, market leadership and ensure Autronica's solutions continue to protect assets, people, and operations across the energy sector.

Preferred locations for the role are Rio de Janeiro or Sao Paulo,  Brazil.

Responsibilities

Your responsibilities as a Regional Sales Manager will be:

Business Growth & Market Leadership

  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities with end users, EPCs, system integrators, MEP, and industrial contractors as well as explore new applications for our solutions in emerging energy markets.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships to expand market penetration and reinforce Autronica's reputation.

Sales & Account Management

  • Deliver accurate forecasts, maintain strong margins, and propose comprehensive fire and gas detection solutions.

Collaboration & Global Alignment

  • Partner with global teams and across functions to engage EPCs, MEPs, engineering firms, and stakeholders and to leverage best practices and market intelligence.

Market Development & Strategy Execution

  • Act as a trusted advisor and build alliances with third-party partners to strengthen market growth.
  • Develop partnerships with end-users, distributors, and industry influencers and ensure Autronica's inclusion on Approved Vendor Lists (AVLs) and organize events with distributors.

Commercial Excellence

  • Lead preparation of major bids, ensure compliance with pricing and approvals, and maximize profitability.

Compliance & Values

  • Ensure adherence to Autronica's ethics, EHS requirements, and company policies.
  • Support continuous improvement across the region.

Who we are looking for

To be successful in this role, you'll bring a proactive, results-driven approach and a strong commercial mindset. You combine strategic vision with hands-on engagement, enjoy building lasting relationships with clients and partners, and thrive in dynamic, multicultural environments where you can make a real impact. You approach challenges with a problem-solving mindset, communicate with clarity and influence, and stay focused and adaptable while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving market.

Qualifications and experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field (Electronics, Electrical, Automation, Controls or relevant).
  • Diversified sales experience in technology-driven industries.
  • Solid experience in selling safety, automation, or related solutions to EPCs, MEP/contractors, system integrators, or end customers in the energy sector.
  • Established regional network and extensive regional market knowledge.
  • Proven experience in instrumentation sales within the oil & gas sector, combined with a strong track record in pursuing and winning EPC (Engineering, Procurement & Construction) projects.
  • Proficient in Salesforce or similar CRM tools for managing pipelines, forecasting, and reporting.

What we offer

We offer excellent development opportunities, a competitive salary and exceptional benefits including the following:

  • An exciting and challenging position in a team with skilled colleagues.
  • Competitive conditions and flexible working time arrangements.
  • A professional work environment where we always strive to deliver and exceed expectations.

Our commitment to you

As an employer of choice, our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity, and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops, and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork, and drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We aim to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback, and always challenging ourselves to do better.

The values that guide us are respect, integrity, inclusion, innovation, and excellence.

We're excited for you to join us and make a difference.

title: Gestor Comercial
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA


DESCRIÇÃO : A Ademicon é a maior administradora independente de consórcios do Brasil. Com mais de 30 anos de história e presença nacional e internacional, somos referência em inovação, solidez e geração de valor para pessoas e empresas que buscam construir patrimônio de forma inteligente. Oferecemos consórcios de imóveis, veículos leves, pesados e serviços, com condições flexíveis e soluções financeiras pensadas para atender diferentes projetos de vida e expansão de negócios.

Com mais de 80 bilhões em créditos ativos e milhares de clientes contemplados, entregamos uma experiência completa: desde o planejamento da compra até a realização do sonho ou investimento. Acreditamos que democratizar o acesso ao crédito e impulsionar o desenvolvimento local são pilares para transformar a vida de famílias e fortalecer empresas. Nossos diferenciais: Especialistas em consórcios de alta performance Atendimento consultivo e personalizado Soluções sob medida para pessoas físicas e jurídicas Gestão transparente e sólida Mais de 130 mil clientes ativos Ampliação de patrimônio sem juros bancários.

Buscamos Gestor Comercial com visão empreendedora e habilidade de relacionamento com clientes diversos (PF e PJ). O dia a dia envolve a gestão de equipes, atuação com vendas consultivas de produtos financeiros – Consórcio de Carro, Imóveis e Serviços - com foco na construção de relacionamentos sólidos e de longo prazo, assim como a atração e capacitação de novos consultores.

Nosso propósito é trazer impacto financeiro positivo para famílias e negócios.

Trabalho preferencialmente presencial com flexibilidade de horário.

Principais atividades:

  • Gestão e treinamento constante da equipe de Vendas;

  • Atração e capacitação de novos consultores de Vendas;

  • Acompanhamento e desenvolvimento de consultores na jornada de vendas e processos administrativos da gestão de carteira de clientes;

  • Prospecção ativa de clientes potenciais (PF e PJ), venda de serviços financeiros, gestão de carteira de clientes e pós venda;

  • Agendamento e condução de reuniões com clientes potenciais englobando: identificação de necessidade, apresentação de soluções / produtos, simulação de cenários, negociação de propostas e fechamento de vendas;

  • Gestão do cliente no pós venda desde a gestão estratégica da carteira até os processos administrativos essenciais dos produtos adquiridos;

REQUISITOS DA VAGA


Pré-Requisitos:

  • Sólida experiência com gestão de equipes de vendas;

  • Forte vivência na área comercial;

  • Experiência com vendas de produtos financeiros será um plus;

  • Alta ambição de carreira e visão empreendedora;

  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de relacionamento interpessoal;

  • Independência, autonomia com alto foco em resultados e performance;

  • Capacidade de trabalhar com metas e prazos de entrega de resultados.

BENEFÍCIOS DA VAGA


O que oferecemos:· Contrato PJ 100% comissionada sem limite de ganhos;

  • Perspectiva de rendimentos acima da média do mercado;

  • Escritório moderno e bem equipado para reuniões presenciais;

  • Plano de carreira estruturado com perspectiva de ascensão rápida;

  • Treinamento e capacitação técnica diferenciada com foco em alta performance.

Benefícios

Nossos Pilares:

PENSAMOS GRANDE: Nós nos desafiamos e sempre queremos ter mais da vida.

SOMOS EMPREENDEDORES: Fazemos o nosso sucesso, vestimos a camisa da empresa. Ademicon é nosso sobrenome.

MENTE ABERTA: Aceitamos mudanças e somos motivados por elas. Inovamos e fazemos de forma diferenciada.

CORRENTE DO BEM: Nossa essência e nossos resultados estão nas pessoas. Somos humanos.

• Liderar diretamente as equipes de recepção, concierge e apoio, garantindo postura profissional, disciplina, alinhamento e entrega de resultados.

• Atuar junto à médica na definição de metas mensais de faturamento, atendimento e performance da clínica.


• Traduzir metas em planos de ação claros, com responsabilidades definidas para a equipe.


• Acompanhar indicadores de resultado, analisando dados e propondo ajustes estratégicos.

• Garantir o funcionamento organizado, eficiente e padronizado da clínica.


• Supervisionar organização, limpeza, abastecimento e estrutura física.


• Acompanhar a agenda diária e apoiar a recepção em momentos críticos.

• Gerenciar fornecedores, prestadores de serviço e demandas do centro empresarial.

• Conduzir processos de contratação e desligamento (entrevistas, documentação, integração e comunicação).

• Solicitar e organizar assinaturas de termos internos e documentos da equipe.


• Manter interface com contabilidade e parceiros relacionados à gestão de pessoas.


• Apoiar na revisão e gestão de contratos médicos, quando necessário.

5. Gestão Financeira e Compras


• Conferir repasses médicos e pagamentos.


• Controlar despesas operacionais e realizar pagamentos via Pix, quando aplicável.


• Realizar compras de insumos, materiais e itens sazonais.


• Gerenciar orçamento operacional, buscando eficiência, controle e redução de desperdícios.

6. Serviços Terceirizados e Estrutura


• Contratar e acompanhar serviços terceirizados (limpeza, TI, manutenção predial, dedetização, entre outros).


• Gerenciar manutenção preventiva da estrutura e de TI.


• Controlar uniformes, ajustes e fornecedores relacionados.

Descrição da vaga

A Aegea
Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária
A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom
O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

description:
O Analista de Departamento Pessoal tem um papel essencial no nosso Back Office: garantir que a jornada das pessoas na empresa seja organizada, segura, transparente e em conformidade com a legislação.

Em um mercado de investimentos que se move em ritmo acelerado, é o Departamento Pessoal que cuida dos bastidores que sustentam tudo isso: admissões, folha, benefícios, férias, ponto e demais processos, assegurando que cada etapa aconteça com atenção aos detalhes, responsabilidade e cuidado com as pessoas. Aqui, o operacional encontra o estratégico, e cada ação impacta diretamente a experiência do time.

Buscamos alguém BOM, DO BEM e AGRADÁVEL. Um(a) profissional com olhar analítico, senso de dono e compromisso com a melhoria contínua, que entenda a importância da legislação trabalhista, goste de processos bem estruturados e tenha prazer em apoiar líderes e colaboradores com clareza e organização.

Se você se sente realizado(a) ao garantir que tudo esteja em dia, bem-feito e funcionando nos bastidores, gosta de rotina, controles, prazos e também de evoluir processos, essa vaga pode ser o seu próximo passo

Ficou interessado(a)? Confira os requisitos abaixo e venha jogar junto com a gente, do jeito certo e indo além.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Saúde e Segurança Corporativa

  • Controlar os Programas de Saúde Ocupacional, realizando o agendamento de exames admissionais, periódicos, de mudança de função e demissionais junto à prestadora;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das Normas Regulamentadoras do TEM;
  • Gerir a documentação obrigatória dos programas de saúde ocupacional, acompanhando prazos e validações;
  • Apoiar e promover as atividades da CIPA e a organização da SIPAT.

Administração de Pessoal

  • Atender e orientar colaboradores sobre todas as rotinas de administração de pessoal;
  • Executar e acompanhar os processos de admissão, afastamento e desligamento (até o pagamento das verbas rescisórias);
  • Conduzir o processo de contratação e controle documental (checklist, ficha funcional, contratos, termos, atualizações de CTPS, entre outros);
  • Realizar cadastros e atualizações de colaboradores nos sistemas internos (Convenia, Ponto Mais e demais sistemas de apoio);
  • Gerir o sistema de controle de ponto, orientando colaboradores e gestores, e enviar relatórios de horas extras e banco de horas à contabilidade externa;
  • Revisar e controlar os cálculos da folha de pagamento, encargos trabalhistas, férias, rescisões, guias de recolhimento, conectividade social e demais obrigações legais;
  • Conferir e encaminhar informações de FOPAG ao Financeiro para programação de pagamentos, bem como notas fiscais de prestadores de serviços;
  • Operacionalizar afastamentos de colaboradores, incluindo abertura de CAT quando aplicável, e aplicar normas legais para gestantes e outros afastamentos previstos em lei;
  • Conduzir o processo de offboarding de ponta a ponta, garantindo a segurança das informações e a homologação conforme legislação vigente;
  • Encaminhar entrevistas de desligamento, consolidar dados e gerar indicadores mensais;
  • Garantir o correto registro, organização e guarda da documentação dos colaboradores (digital e física, quando necessário).

Gestão de Benefícios

  • Administrar os benefícios corporativos, realizando inclusões e exclusões de beneficiários e garantindo correta operacionalização e descontos em folha (Unimed, SulAmérica, Ifood Benefícios, vale-transporte, entre outros);
  • Gerir o cadastro da Nomos e de seus CNPJs no PAT (Programa de Alimentação do Trabalhador);
  • Acompanhar acordos sindicais e legislação vigente, assegurando sua aplicação nas políticas internas.

Controle e Gestão de Férias

title: Aviation Logistics Specialist
description:
Important To make sure your application is considered, please submit it before the end of the day on ):

We encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

What does the job involve?


Responsible for management within one or more areas like sea surveillance, emergency preparedness, rig move operation, supply bases, helicopters, vessels, transportation, and other logistical assets. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring safe, efficient and effective utilization of these assets to support operations. This includes coordinating with internal stakeholders, such as operations and maintenance teams, to ensure that logistical assets are available and operational when needed. Contribute to the organization's ability to deliver resources and services in a risk-based, timely and reliable manner.

You are utilizing your knowledge independently to solve highly complex tasks with a short to medium-term tactical impact/risk. You address key business challenges that align with Equinor's short and long-term strategy via providing specialist support to your team and others. You independently communicate within the immediate team, across other areas, and towards key stakeholders from partners or external parties. You regularly navigate conflicting agendas and may lead negotiations with senior stakeholders. You resolve challenges, deliver improvements and contribute to shaping best practices. You promote change initiatives, demonstrate flexibility to adopt new highly complex activities/ways of working and advice others. You follow and comply with safety, ethics, and compliance requirements and align with leadership expectations and company values. Full band description can be found on Insight.

What will my tasks be?


Within this position, your key tasks will be to:

  • Monitor and report on monthly Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and follow-up actions to enhance operational performance.
  • Drive initiatives aimed at improving aviation processes and procedures.
  • Review and update operational procedures periodic to ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations. Stay updated on relevant aviation legislation and ensure compliance across operations.
  • Follow up with air operator regarding maintenance planning and maintain an action log.
  • Close follow up with Flight safety department in Norway. Set up and follow up on the annual flight safety verification process to ensure adherence to safety protocols.
  • Identify cost accrual opportunities and implement reduction initiatives to optimize budget efficiency.
  • Monitor and report on fleet availability to ensure optimal operational readiness.
  • Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to enhance air traffic management and operational flow.

Here's what we expect from you:


At Equinor, there are some overall qualities we regard as essential. We want you to identify with the values that guide our decisions and help us succeed and grow: open, collaborative, courageous and caring. We expect you to make safety your priority and to contribute to our zero-harm culture. And for this specific position, we are also looking for:

  • Minimum 10 years of relevant experience with aviation logistics. Bachelor's degree preferably in Mechanical or Aeronautical Engineering or related areas.
  • At least 5 years of experience in helicopter maintenance and operations/logistics, OR similar field of study with proven experience in aviation engineering.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and in English (written and spoken).
  • Resilient, Communicative, great orator.
  • Collaborative spirit – focus on finding solutions alongside their team. Loves working as a team.
  • Proven experience in monitoring and analyzing aviation-related KPIs.
  • Experience in reviewing and updating operational procedures in compliance with industry standards.
  • Experience in maintenance planning and aircraft management.
  • Ability to work under pressure attending multiple stakeholders.

What can we offer you?


We want you to have a rewarding and fulfilling work life. That's why we offer:

Not just a job - a career

In Equinor, your development begins on day one. You will build your competence through a wide range of learning activities while being empowered to build your career across multiple disciplines and geographies. Our internal job market allows a wide range of opportunities for development and growth within your own field, or even in other areas you find interesting and relevant.

Attractive rewards

We give you a comprehensive benefits package with a competitive salary, global parental leave, bonus scheme and pension plan.

Wellness and work-life balance

We care about and prioritise our employees' well-being. We know that for you to be the best version of yourself in the workplace, being able to collect your children, attend a class or simply enjoy social time can be invaluable. That's why we encourage you to make use of our flexible work arrangements wherever possible.

An inclusive culture

We believe embracing our differences makes us stronger. For us, true inclusion means being able to bring your whole self to work, and for you and everyone else to feel accepted and valued.

Equal opportunities for everyone


Equinor is an equal-opportunity employer. We make all employment decisions, which include hiring, promotion, transfer, demotion, termination, and training, without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, marital status, parental status, veteran status, or any other protected status.

As part of this commitment, reasonable adjustments will be made during the recruitment process for candidates with disabilities or long-term health conditions. If you have any specific requirements, please clarify this in your application and our team will be in contact to see how we can support your needs.

Important notes about the application process


We expect you to openly offer all relevant information about yourself during the recruitment process. Background checks are performed on all final candidates, and all permanent and temporary hires will be screened using relevant sanctions lists to ensure compliance with sanctions laws. When applying for a job in Norway you will be asked for information on affiliation to high-risk countries for a security assessment.

About Equinor


Equinor is an international energy company headquartered in Norway, energising the lives of 170 million people worldwide. Our ambition is to be a leading company in the energy transition and achieve net zero by 2050. Our task is enormous: supplying the world with the energy it needs, while lowering emissions to the atmosphere. To achieve it, we are looking for like-minded people to join our team of 25,000 colleagues working in more than 20 countries. We're up for the challenge. Are you?

Analista de VMO e Modelagem Financeira

O Analista de VMO (Value Management Office) será responsável por apoiar a mensuração de valor dos projetos da companhia, garantindo que os benefícios esperados sejam identificados, acompanhados e convertidos em dados e indicadores claros. Requisitos

  • Conhecimento em análise econômica e/ou modelagem financeira.

Nossa história começa em 1894, com o Club de Regatas Botafogo, e se desdobra em 1904, com o surgimento do Botafogo Football Club. Posteriormente, a fusão entre eles, deu origem ao Botafogo de Futebol e Regatas, 1942. O Clube é reconhecido como o "Glorioso", por seus feitos e conquistas ao longo de toda a sua trajetória no futebol, e conta com uma torcida apaixonada a nível nacional e internacional. Até os dias de hoje, o Alvinegro é o clube que mais cedeu jogadores para a Seleção Brasileira em Copas do Mundo, contribuindo diretamente para três títulos mundiais do Brasil, quando foi base das seleções campeãs em 1958, 1962 e 1970.

O Time da Estrela Solitária é por natureza um verdadeiro celeiro de craques e conta com uma coletânea incomparável de ídolos. Os maiores de todos os tempos vestiram a camisa do Mais Tradicional. Entre suas taças e glórias em campo, o Botafogo é Tricampeão brasileiro e campeão da Libertadores, e segue escrevendo sua história vitoriosa nos gramados.

SAF BOTAFOGO 彡

Liderada por John Textor, a SAF Botafogo assumiu o controle do futebol do Mais Tradicional em março de 2022, sendo pioneira na constituição de um Clube-Empresa no país.

Tendo um projeto ambicioso e profissional como direcionamento, a SAF busca construir um novo Botafogo, forte, vitorioso e inspirador, juntamente com seus verdadeiros donos, os seus torcedores apaixonados.

ALLOS
é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a
Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls
, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Execução das rotinas que geram entregas e produtos da área sendo responsável pela coleta, atualização e divulgação de reports da área;
  • Responsável pela elaboração de análises que visam a garantia do processo de BI dos KPIs operacionais, utilizando ferramentas de análise de dados (Power BI);
  • Responsável pelo acompanhamento da performance dos KPIs dos shoppings e suas devidas explicações qualitativas.
  • Suporte e atendimento aos shoppings

  • Ensino superior Completo;

Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de uma Consultora Sênior de Gestão de Mudança Organizacional para atuar em um programa de transformação SAP de alta complexidade, envolvendo redesenho de processos, adoção de melhores práticas e rollout de SAP S/4HANA. Procuramos uma profissional com forte capacidade de articulação executiva, entrega hands-on, governança de stakeholders e domínio metodológico em Change Management aplicado a programas de tecnologia de missão crítica.

Neste papel estratégico, você será responsável por estruturar e orquestrar a estratégia de mudança, promovendo o alinhamento entre áreas, mitigando resistências, acelerando a adoção e sustentando a nova cultura operacional.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar a estratégia de Gestão de Mudança da transformação SAP, abrangendo comunicação, engajamento, readiness, treinamento e gestão de impactos organizacionais.
  • Realizar diagnósticos de maturidade e análises de impacto (OIA – Organizational Impact Assessment) para identificar gaps comportamentais, operacionais e culturais.
  • Preparar e conduzir rituais executivos, Steering Committees e touchpoints com áreas de negócio, garantindo alinhamento entre C-Level, PMO, TI e frentes funcionais SAP.
  • Desenvolver e implementar planos de comunicação multicanal, traduzindo temas técnicos SAP para mensagens claras, pragmáticas e orientadas ao negócio.
  • Estruturar e gerir o plano de treinamento SAP (Training Strategy, TNA – Training Needs Assessment, cronograma e execução), assegurando aderência ao modelo de rollout.
  • Liderar a gestão da mudança durante cutover e hiper-care, garantindo readiness da organização, mitigação de riscos e aderência ao novo operating model.
  • Atuar como ponte entre as equipes funcionais SAP (Financeiro, Logística, IS-U, etc.) e as áreas de negócio na interpretação dos impactos dos novos processos.
  • Elaborar dashboards executivos de Change Management, KPIs e indicadores de adoção.
  • Garantir alinhamento às metodologias internas (SAP Activate, Clean Core, TAO quando aplicável) e melhores práticas globais de GMO.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada em Gestão de Mudança para projetos SAP, em fases de implementação, rollout ou migração para SAP S/4HANA.
  • Senioridade para atuar em ambientes complexos, multigeográficos e politicamente sensíveis.
  • Forte capacidade de comunicação executiva, com narrativa clara e estruturação de mensagens estratégicas.
  • Fluência em inglês e espanhol para condução de workshops, reports e governança multinacional.
  • Vivência com frameworks de Change Management (ADKAR, Prosci, Kotter, etc.), combinados com práticas de transformação digital.
  • Experiência em gestão de stakeholders e condução de rituais executivos em grandes organizações.
  • Capacidade de traduzir temas tecnológicos em impactos de negócio e comportamentais.

Diferenciais

  • Background híbrido (Processos, PMO, Comunicação Interna, Treinamento, Cultura).

title: Safety Advisor
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview

We are seeking a
Safety Advisor
to join the Saudi Aramco Loss Prevention organization (LP).

LP is responsible for providing both day-to-day in-field occupational and process safety support to Saudi Aramco operations, as well as centralized technical support and consulting function. Our field offices are located in Abqaiq, Riyadh, Ras Tanura, Dhahran, Udhailiyah, Jeddah (including Yanbu and Jazan), and Tanajib. Through these offices, LP provides its services to all Saudi Aramco facilities and departments that are located throughout the Kingdom.

Your primary role is to provide daily support to company facilities and departments, helping them effectively implement the Saudi Aramco Safety Management System expectations and associated programs, as well as assuring compliance to all company safety requirements.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Facilitate implementation of the Saudi Aramco Safety Management System, as well as its objectives and expectations, including developing associated safety processes, and participating in self-assessments.
  • Conduct field inspections/reviews to assess compliance to company and international codes and standards, identify safety concerns, formulate solutions, and develop practical and cost-effective corrective actions.
  • Identify, evaluate, recommend actions, and follow up on critical, yet universal safety tasks and control methodologies related to operational safety practices (e.g., work at height, isolation/LOTO, permit to work, hydrogen sulfide, confined space entry, excavations).
  • Participate in safety studies/activities using risk assessment and mitigation methodologies, such as: PHAs, HAZOPs, JSAs, incident investigations, compliance reviews, or insurance surveys.
  • Respond to emergency situations and incidents, either during or after regular working hours, to provide technical assistance and advice.
  • Participate in worksite contractor safety management activities (e.g., contractor selection and prequalification, monitoring of work site compliance, and measurement of performance).
  • Support the reporting, classification and investigation all incidents, and participating in incident investigations, determination of root causes, and proper recommendations to prevent recurrence.
  • Deliver Loss Prevention-specific training to employees, contractors, and outside parties.
  • Mentor other LP personnel.

Minimum Requirements

  • You will hold a Bachelor of Science degree from an Accredited Institution and seven years of experience areas in the oil and gas, petrochemicals, or related industries, such as: operations and maintenance, plant engineering, construction, turnaround and inspection, safety program development, process safety, and audits/assessments.
  • Or you will have 15 years of relevant industry experience in the oil and gas, petrochemicals, or related industries, including a strong track record in delivering results, as referenced above, without a degree.
  • You will also have an excellent ability to communicate in English with peers as well as members of management, and be able to produce clear and concise oral and written reports in English.

Working Environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world's biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Americas Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and.>

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions in various locations to drive partnerships for licensing and embedding Ubuntu and Ubuntu Pro into software and SaaS solutions.

Canonical supports ISV customers and alliances in building on Ubuntu and Ubuntu Pro, which helps them deliver fast, reliable, secure, compliant and consistent solutions.

We offer the world's most extensive base of open source software, backed by comprehensive SLA support, FIPS‑certified cryptographic compliance, and security commitments that meet HIPAA and FedRAMP standards. We are the top‑rated operating system for developers. Partnering with every major public cloud provider, we ensure Ubuntu is optimized and seamlessly integrated with their unique services, making it easier for ISVs to deploy solutions confidently across multi‑cloud environments. Additionally, we collaborate with leading server manufacturers, IoT providers, and silicon vendors to enable, optimize, and certify Ubuntu on their hardware. This makes Ubuntu an exceptional choice for ISVs selling physical appliances or traditional software solutions.

The world's biggest brands in AI build on these Ubuntu Pro capabilities to ensure they stay focused on their product proposition rather than maintenance or compliance.

Location

Multiple openings in the Americas and in E time zones.

Role Overview

The Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions will collaborate with Product, Alliances, Sales, Business Development, and Marketing colleagues to prospect into ISV accounts, introduce our offerings, and help partners or potential customers develop their products to best leverage our portfolio. The successful candidate will:

  • Drive embedded support and licensing sales with ISVs to exceed quarterly and annual booking targets.
  • Lead customer and partner relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales, customer success and support lifecycle.
  • Deepen understanding and engagement with the open source ecosystem.
  • Identify and develop partnerships that support Canonical's strategic ambitions.
  • Collaborate with product management to ensure fitness and enhancement of our platforms and solutions for ISVs.
  • Negotiate contracts with new and existing ISV partners and customers.
  • Shape our content and messaging for ISV partners and customers.

What We Are Looking For

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about an alternative chosen path.
  • Ability to establish strategic relationships with large organisations at all levels.
  • A passion for technology and extensive experience with the software and SaaS industry, Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred), the open source ecosystem, cloud models, and container service offerings.
  • Experience with lead generation and business development in the software sector.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.
  • Outstanding business English writing and presentation skills.
  • A personal drive to meet commitments and a track record of delivering beyond expectations.
  • A commitment to leadership, skills development and mentorship.
  • An appreciation of diversity and effectiveness in a multicultural, multi‑national organisation.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long.

  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

title: Chief Audit Officer
description:
Join to apply for the Chief Audit Officer role at Inside Higher Ed

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Howard University is seeking a Chief Audit Officer (CAO) who serves as the institution’s senior audit executive, leading the internal audit function with authority and independence to provide objective assurance and advisory services across all university operations. The CAO plays a critical role in protecting institutional assets, enhancing operational effectiveness, and supporting the achievement of strategic objectives through systematic evaluation and improvement of risk management, internal controls, and governance processes.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Planning & Audit Execution

  • Develop and annually update a comprehensive, risk‑based internal audit plan aligned with the university’s strategic priorities, emerging risks, and compliance requirements
  • Present the annual audit plan to the Audit Committee for review and approval, adapting priorities dynamically in response to changing institutional needs
  • Direct and oversee all internal audit engagements, including financial, operational, compliance, information technology, and investigative audits
  • Ensure audit work is performed in accordance with the International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing (IIA Standards)
  • Implement and maintain a quality assurance and improvement program, including periodic external assessments
  • Coordinate audit activities with external auditors and regulatory agencies to maximize coverage and minimize redundancy

Reporting & Communication

  • Prepare and present comprehensive audit reports to the President, senior leadership, and Audit Committee, including findings, risk ratings, and actionable recommendations
  • Communicate significant risk exposures, control deficiencies, and governance concerns to the Audit Committee in a timely and transparent manner
  • Provide quarterly status reports on audit plan progress, emerging risks, follow‑up on prior recommendations, and resource utilization
  • Meet privately with the Audit Committee without management present to discuss sensitive matters
  • Review audit workpapers, findings, and reports to ensure quality, accuracy, and appropriate support for conclusions

Risk Management & Advisory Services

  • Conduct ongoing enterprise risk assessments in collaboration with senior leadership to identify and prioritize audit areas
  • Monitor the institutional risk environment, including emerging risks related to technology, cybersecurity, research integrity, Title IX, athletics, sponsored programs, and student services
  • Provide advisory services and consultation on new systems, processes, policies, and strategic initiatives from a risk and control perspective
  • Track regulatory and legal developments affecting higher education, including federal and state requirements, accreditation standards, and grant compliance
  • Facilitate training and awareness programs on internal controls, fraud prevention, ethics, and risk management

Investigations & Special Projects

  • Lead or oversee investigations into allegations of fraud, financial irregularities, policy violations, or misconduct with appropriate confidentiality and due process
  • Coordinate with Human Resources, General Counsel, and law enforcement as appropriate during investigations
  • Conduct special projects and ad hoc reviews at the request of the Audit Committee, President, or senior leadership

Independence & Professional Standards

  • Maintain organizational independence and individual objectivity in all audit activities, free from interference in determining scope, performing work, and communicating results
  • Uphold the IIA Code of Ethics and maintain professional skepticism in all engagements
  • Ensure the internal audit function has unrestricted access to records, personnel, and physical properties relevant to audit activities
  • Avoid conflicts of interest and recuse from audits where independence may be compromised

Team Leadership & External Coordination

  • Recruit, supervise, mentor, and evaluate internal audit staff, fostering professional development and maintaining a high‑performing team
  • Promote continuing professional education and certification for audit staff
  • Manage the internal audit budget and allocate resources effectively to achieve audit plan objectives
  • Serve as the primary liaison with external auditors for financial statement audits, federal compliance audits (Single Audit), and NCAA agreed‑upon procedures
  • Manage relationships with external firms engaged for specialized audits or consulting services

Qualifications

Education

  • Required: Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, business administration, or related field
  • Preferred: Master's degree in accounting, business administration (MBA), public administration (MPA), or related discipline

Certifications

  • Required: At least one of the following professional certifications:
    • Certified Internal Auditor (CIA)
    • Certified Public Accountant (CPA)
    • Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)
  • Preferred: Multiple relevant certifications demonstrating breadth of expertise

Experience

  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive internal audit experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership or management role
  • Demonstrated experience in higher education, public sector, nonprofit, or similarly complex organizational environments strongly preferred
  • Proven track record of developing and executing risk‑based audit plans and managing audit engagements from planning through reporting
  • Experience presenting audit findings and recommendations to audit committees or boards of directors

Knowledge & Skills

  • Comprehensive understanding of the International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing and the COSO Internal Control Framework
  • Strong knowledge of governance, enterprise risk management, and compliance frameworks (e.g., COSO ERM, ISO 31000)
  • Familiarity with higher education regulations including Title IV financial aid, OMB Uniform Guidance, research compliance, NCAA rules, and FERPA
  • Proficiency in data analytics tools and audit management software
  • Understanding of information technology controls, cybersecurity risks, and IT audit methodologies
  • Knowledge of fraud detection and prevention techniques

Competencies

  • Leadership: Ability to lead and inspire a professional team, influence organizational change, and navigate complex institutional environments

Solution Seeker - with headquarters in Norway and a subsidiary in Brazil - is a scaleup building software and AI for industrial production optimization, turning data into value and strategic insight for our users.

You thrive in a young, international, fast-paced environment where your passion for continuous learning and innovation drives your success. description:
Oil Reservoir Management Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Please note that this role is based in Saudi Arabia on a permanent, residential basis.

Overview

We are seeking an Oil Reservoir Management Engineer with extensive experience in Oil Reservoir Management to join our Exploration and Petroleum Engineering Center in Dhahran. Our Center provides expert advice and guidance on all aspects of oil reservoir management, including designing, participating in and implementing best‑in‑class reservoir management programs. This position is embedded within the Petroleum Engineering business and as a senior technical specialist, you will engage with leaders and experts from across the upstream business.

Your primary role is to manage some of the world’s largest onshore and offshore oil fields, conduct pioneering research, introduce new technologies and provide specialized engineering services as part of the customized reservoir management practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide guidance and oversight on best-in-class reservoir management tenets, practices and state of the art technologies for all Saudi Aramco hydrocarbon assets.
  • Formulate reservoir development, data acquisition, strategic surveillance and monitoring master-plans to ensure optimal development and depletion strategies.
  • Utilize reservoir management standards and guidelines to enhance both net present value and hydrocarbon recovery.
  • Lead, design and participate in integrated field reviews and field development plans.
  • Prepare reservoir engineering input into drilling and work-over proposals and programs.
  • Recommend advanced completion techniques for horizontal and multi-lateral wells.
  • Lead and participate in reservoir engineering studies that include reservoir stimulation modeling of various International Offshore Rule (IOR) processes for improvement of ultimate recovery.
  • Participate in technical societies and technical groups.

Qualifications

  • Hold a Bachelor degree in Petroleum Engineering or related discipline. A Master degree or PhD is desirable, but not required.
  • Have a minimum of 10 years related experience including at least 7 years specializing in oil reservoir management. A training history of appropriate specialized courses and seminars is expected. Technical publications are valued but in‑depth practical experience is paramount.
  • Must have full professional proficiency in English required to interact and communicate clearly with specialists in geology, core and fluid analysis, petrophysics, simulation, drilling, completion, production and facilities.
  • Must have working knowledge of open‑hole and cased‑hole logs, geological modeling, simulation, completion and production procedures and technologies.
  • Technical knowledge and expertise are required in formation evaluation, geological modeling, simulation, reservoir appraisal and field development planning, completion, production/injection procedures, strategy technologies, water flooding, reservoir surveillance, SCAL, PVT, geochemical analysis and fluid compatibility. Additionally, expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and data analytics are desirable but not required.
  • Must have history of using modern reservoir management practices for oil reservoirs.

Working Environment

Our high‑performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly. At Aramco, our people work on truly world‑scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. We invest heavily in talent development and encourage continuous learning through extensive workforce development programs.

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Procuramos uma pessoa desenvolvedora apaixonada por desafios, tecnologia e conhecimento. Essa pessoa, junto ao time, será responsável por:

Estamos em busca de um Coordenador de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TI que será responsável por coordenar as atividades de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura de TI, garantindo a proteção dos ativos digitais e o funcionamento estável e seguro dos ambientes corporativos e críticos da empresa de energia. Atuar como elo entre a estratégia definida pela Superintendência e a execução pelas equipes técnicas, assegurando conformidade regulatória, resiliência operacional e alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.

A nossa empresa é feita por gente. Nós já fazemos parte do seu dia. Agora, queremos que você faça parte do nosso dia a dia.

Traga a sua energia para a Light !

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Seus desafios serão:

  • Liderar a equipe de Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura, promovendo integração entre processos, pessoas e tecnologia.
  • Implementar e manter políticas, normas e controles de segurança alinhados a frameworks como ISO 27001, NIST CSF, IEC 62443, LGPD e regulamentos setoriais (ANEEL, ONS).
  • Coordenar atividades de gestão de vulnerabilidades, hardening, monitoração e resposta a incidentes (TI e OT).
  • Apoiar a operação do SNOC (Security & Network Operations Center) e a interface com o CSIRT, garantindo tempos de resposta adequados a incidentes.
  • Supervisionar a gestão de identidades e acessos (IAM), controles de rede, servidores e sistemas críticos.
  • Apoiar o planejamento e a execução de projetos de infraestrutura de TI, assegurando que os requisitos de segurança estejam integrados desde o desenho.
  • Garantir continuidade operacional e planos de recuperação de desastres (BCP/DRP).
  • Promover campanhas de conscientização em segurança e boas práticas para colaboradores e fornecedores.
  • Interagir com áreas regulatórias, auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo evidências de conformidade.
  • Reportar periodicamente à Superintendência o status da segurança, principais riscos e indicadores de desempenho.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que é necessário você ter:

  • Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia, Segurança da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Segurança da Informação (obrigatório).
  • Certificações valorizadas: CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, CompTIA Security+, ITIL, Azure/AWS Security, ou IEC 62443.
  • Experiência comprovada em:
  • Segurança da Informação: gestão de vulnerabilidades, SNOC, IAM, políticas, auditorias.
  • Infraestrutura de TI: administração de servidores (Windows/Linux), redes, storage, gestão de ambientes críticos.
  • Resiliência Operacional: continuidade de negócios, backup, DRP.
  • Vivência em empresas de energia ou setores críticos será diferencial.
  • Conhecimento em Inteligência Artificial aplicada à Segurança da Informação (uso de IA para detecção de ameaças, análise comportamental e automação de resposta a incidentes).

Informações adicionais

O que temos para você:

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Auxílio farmácia;
  • Participação nos Lucros ou Resultados;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras;
  • Programa de treinamentos.

title: Design Director, UI/UX & Brand
description:
Design Director, UI/UX & Brand

Join to apply for the Design Director, UI/UX & Brand role at Darkroom

About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About The Role

We are hiring a Design Director - a visionary leader with a strong design background who thrives in driving high-quality design execution across various platforms as well as managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

This role requires deep experience in branded UI/UX design. You’re a senior‑level design lead that can independently own multiple web design engagements simultaneously. Navigating client feedback and pushback is an everyday muscle you successfully work with. You can show deep experience in being able to thread the needle between game‑changing UI, conversion‑oriented UX, and technical feasibility, all on a tight timeline. Clients are consistently impressed by your knowledge of e‑commerce heuristics and how you combine that with unique and branded design. You love working with developers to understand how to make your ideas come to life and sell clients on design solutions and tradeoffs they have to make to complete engagements on‑time.

You pride yourself on being able to effortlessly spin up a new brand design system for a client that feels differentiated, elevated, and informed by your strategic market analysis. You have consistently merged business thinking with exceptional visual craft into scalable brand identities that work across paid media, retention, web, social, and packaging.

In addition to your individual contributor responsibilities, you will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e‑commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.

This role requires a balance of creativity, business strategy, and leadership in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment. You’ll work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure the alignment of design goals with broader business objectives. Your ability to drive creative strategy and manage multiple projects with precision will be essential to your success. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities

  • Lead 1-3 UI/UX engagements as needed, focusing on creating branded e-commerce websites.
  • Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.
  • Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.
  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.
  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.

Management Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 2-4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.
  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.
  • Ensure high‑quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.
  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.

You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You

  • 3-6+ years of senior‑level web design experience with e-commerce companies, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in responsive web design.
  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.
  • Self‑motivated, proactive, and detail‑oriented with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.
  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.
  • Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.
  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.
  • Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.
  • Bonus: Familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote, employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model, including weekly in‑office appearances. Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Director

title: Head of Brand, Marketing and Promotion
description:
Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), which for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Position Overview

The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.
  • Responsible for all promotional aspects including any communications designed and required to support the commercial and marketing objectives of the tournament.
  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones.
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to create dedicated local, regional or national promotional activities that support the objectives of the tournament, the marketing strategy, or any relevant stakeholders such as commercial partners, media partners, host cities, and others.
  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property, including but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.
  • Oversee the correct implementation and utilization of all in-market tournament brand asset implementations and applications including, but not limited to, event and stadium dressing, experiential marketing applications, retail branding, and any other use of the brand assets by FIFA’s internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage procurement and legal processes (in compliance with FWWC27 LTDA policies and guidelines) as it relates to the tendering and contracting of local, regional or national suppliers, service providers, agencies, and other.
  • Manage and deliver all necessary reporting measures related to the tournament.
  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.

Your Profile

  • Bachelor’s degree or similar higher education in marketing, or a marketing related discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in a relevant leadership position.
  • Proven experience delivering major brand & marketing plans.
  • Experience in the sports and/or entertainment industry is a major plus.
  • Experience working in a global or international environment.
  • Proven track record in managing a team in a matrix or similar structure.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills and the ability to manage up, down and sideways.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Profound knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets and culture.
  • Ability to work to deadlines and stress resilient.
  • Financial and budget management.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Additional Information

  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Contract
  • Job function: Marketing and Sales

Trabalhar na Engemon significa integrar uma empresa com uma história rica, enfrentar uma diversidade de projetos estimulantes, ter oportunidades para o desenvolvimento pessoal, fazer parte de uma cultura organizacional que preza pela colaboração, saúde e bem-estar, e contribuir para projetos que geram impactos positivos. Our Engineering team helps Nubank to create and use the technology that provides us to build the best financial products. While we value candidates that are familiar with them, we are also confident that software engineers who are interested in joining Nubank will be able to learn from our team. We value working in small, independent teams that feel like small startups within the company, and eschew coupling and centralizing where realistic. We understand that execution is the key to success and optimize processes to remove bottlenecks.

  • Work with large scale distributed systems, understanding their broad architecture

  • Participate in on-call rotations for your team and respond to incidents as necessary
  • Work focused on backend applications, and be open to contribute to mobile and frontend development, according to business needs

We are looking for a person who has

  • At least 10 years of experience developing digital products in complex environments
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices architecture, and cloud technologies
  • Proven track record of designing and delivering large-scale systems that serve thousands (or even millions) of users
  • Strong background in object-oriented or functional programming languages, with ability to work across multiple languages
