title: MSF Access Executive Director
description:
Location: Strong preference to be based in one of the five MSF Access Regional Hubs (Rio de Janeiro, Dakar, Brussels, Nairobi, and Kuala Lumpur). Placement in associated strategic locations may be considered.

Duration: MSF office contract, minimum 3 years commitment, extendable by 3 years, according to MSF practice and subject to national labour laws

Deadline to Apply:

Compensation and benefits: MSF practice is to offer the C&B package current in the MSF entity establishing the contract.

Reporting to: The MSF Access Executive Board

Start date: Beginning of Q2 2026 preferred with some flexibility depending on individual circumstances

MSF INTERNATIONAL

Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 24 sections, 28 associations and other offices together. Based in Geneva, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF movement, and implements international projects and initiatives as requested. MSF is committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

POSITION BACKGROUND

Ensuring access to key medical tools is critical to MSF's Social Mission. MSF has been engaged in a wide variety of ways to improve the access situation over the past decades through the vehicle of the Access Campaign. In 2023, MSF’s International General Assembly unanimously voted a Vision that is anchoring addressing Access to Products Healthcare as being integral to its Social Mission:

“Over the coming decade, MSF will pursue and accentuate its activities aimed at delivering tangible improvements in Access to Products for Healthcare for people who are deprived of them. Whilst our actions will be as specific to operational contexts as possible, they will also be as global as necessary to achieve the specific improvements sought. This work will expose and address problems faced by patients and by operational teams, will involve the mobilization of the entire movement towards common ambitions, and will leverage the potential of partnerships. It will also preserve space for innovation and reflect the multiple expressions of our social mission. These activities will be in-depth, diverse in nature and adequately resourced, and we will learn from their successes and failures. These ambitions will be reflected in how we structure and govern this work.”

Médecins Sans Frontières works tirelessly to improve the accessibility, availability, affordability, appropriateness and quality of products for health care for the populations it assists and their communities. While this is a collective effort across the organisation, the MSF Access team plays a central role as it identifies and implements a priority selection of access projects, offers expert support for access activities elsewhere in MSF, and brings together information and analysis relevant to MSF’s access work. The MSF Access team, overseen by an Executive Board, is based around five regional hubs: Kuala Lumpur, Nairobi, Brussels, Dakar and Rio de Janeiro.

PLACE IN THE ORGANISATION

The Executive Director (ED) will be accountable to the MSF Access Executive Board for the proper oversight and management of the MSF Access resources and the execution of MSF Access’s mandate.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION

The ED is responsible for the overall strategic, institutional, and representational leadership of MSF Access. The focus of the ED’s role will be on shepherding the vision, strategy, management, external engagement of MSF Access. Working closely with the Deputy Executive Director (DED), the ED focuses on strategic direction, high-level external representation and engagement, and internal governance and institutional management while the DED ensures medical relevance, rigour and operational grounding.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

The Executive Director’s primary responsibilities will include:

Strategic Leadership, Governance and Accountability

  • Implementation of the strategy vision of MSF Access

  • Leading development, implementation, monitoring and periodic revision of the MSF Access Strategic Plan by means of the annual/multi-year plan and budget

  • Executive leadership of the MSF Access team, including management of the MSF Access management team alongside the Deputy Executive Director

  • Final responsibility for, ongoing engagement with and reporting on the strategic progress, performance, annual budgets and expenditures, and risk mitigation strategies of MSF Access to the Executive Board, and when necessary, other MSF leadership and decision-making platforms such as the Full Executive Committee

  • Promoting processes for reflection, learning and continuous improvement across MSF Access

External Representation and Engagement

  • Representation of MSF Access in critical high-level global health and access discussions including in multilateral fora and processes, in government engagements where requested, with private sector leaders and other relevant stakeholders alongside the MSF Access MT

  • Steer MSF Access’s overall external partnership strategy in alignment with the broader MSF Access strategy and cultivate engagement with key global health and access stakeholders

Internal Leadership and Management

  • Management and coordination of key MSF Access functions (as articulated below) alongside the management team

  • Report to the MSF Access Board on key strategic and governance decisions and with informational updates of note, including but not limited to, major decisions relating to the content of MSF’s Access work, any material engagement with MSF leadership and governance structures, management of the MSF Access MT along with the DED, regular budgetary updates and accountabilities, and alongside the Head of Human Resources any HR issues requiring the attention of the board.

  • Alongside the DED and management team, translating the MSF Access Strategic Plan into annual plans for each respective body of work, including through individual projects and initiatives

  • Oversee development of MSF Access administrative policies and processes and addressing critical human resources issues

  • Development and finalization of the MSF Access annual plan and budget alongside relevant members of the management team

  • Representing MSF Access on the Medical Operational (MedOps) platform (which includes all medical directors and directors of operations across MSF) including participation in MedOps meetings as required

The ED is also responsible for ensuring that MSF Access fulfils its articulated responsibilities to the movement, which are:

  • Advise the Movement on the Common Priorities

  • Provide or source support on access issues to all entities that request it within MSF

  • Design and implement access initiatives to respond to the Common Priorities

  • Maintain an overview and report on access initiatives movement-wide on an annual basis

  • Survey and analyze the external access landscape

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 15+ years of senior management and leadership experience in global health policy, advocacy, institutional management, or humanitarian affairs

  • PhD or Master’s degree in health sciences (medical, (bio)medical, pharmacy) or international relations, public policy, public administration, public health with significant experience working in and knowledge of global health and access issues.

  • Demonstrated experience in global health and access issues in a broad range of subjects relevant to MSF’s medical humanitarian mission and operations.

  • Deep understanding of MSF’s operational and medical nature and its medical humanitarian mission.

  • Advanced managerial capabilities and experience with excellent project management capabilities, multidisciplinary teams and ability to work effectively and independently in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience in developing and maintaining professional relationships with a wide range of stakeholders and organizations, including government officials, multilateral representatives, medical professionals, civil society, community organizations, academia, and global health donor organizations.

  • Experience in strategy development processes and demonstrated strategic thinking capabilities.

  • Proven track record of external engagements and external representation; ability to actively participate in public speaking engagements, including—but not limited to—presenting at conferences, conducting print and broadcast media interviews, and representation in external meetings.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.

MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. MSF expects all staff to share this commitment and promote an environment where abuse and misconduct is not tolerated.

We are committed to removing barriers for people with specific accessibility needs. If you need an adjustment to the recruitment process to be considered for the role, please let us know from the beginning of the selection process.

Note: All offers of employment will be subject to reference checks and to appropriate screening checks. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms his/her/their understanding of these recruitment procedures.

title: Coordenador de TI
description:
Join to apply for the Coordenador de TI role at FONS - Consultoria e Soluções

Missão do Cargo

Liderar e coordenar as atividades de tecnologia da informação, assegurando a estabilidade e o desempenho dos sistemas TOTVS voltados à área da saúde, bem como a eficiência da infraestrutura tecnológica e o suporte de excelência aos usuários internos. O profissional deverá atuar de forma estratégica e operacional, garantindo segurança, continuidade e inovação nos processos tecnológicos da instituição.

Responsabilidades

  • Coordenar a área de TI e garantir a estabilidade dos sistemas corporativos;
  • Gerenciar o sistema TOTVS – módulo Saúde, assegurando seu funcionamento, atualizações e integração com demais sistemas;
  • Atuar diretamente no suporte ao usuário interno, solucionando demandas técnicas e aprimorando processos de uso do sistema;
  • Planejar e implementar melhorias tecnológicas aplicadas ao contexto hospitalar e clínico;
  • Gerenciar contratos e relacionamento com fornecedores de tecnologia, prezando por qualidade e custo-benefício;
  • Zelar pela segurança da informação, integridade dos dados e continuidade dos serviços de TI;
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e indicadores de performance da área;
  • Apoiar a Diretoria em decisões estratégicas relacionadas a tecnologia e inovação.

Atividades do Dia a Dia

  • Monitorar o desempenho e disponibilidade dos sistemas TOTVS e demais plataformas utilizadas;
  • Supervisionar backups, atualizações, rede interna e infraestrutura de servidores;
  • Atender e direcionar chamados técnicos com foco na satisfação do usuário interno;
  • Manter inventário atualizado de equipamentos e licenças;
  • Promover treinamentos internos sobre uso do sistema e boas práticas de segurança digital;
  • Coordenar equipe de suporte técnico e acompanhar o cumprimento de SLA’s;
  • Realizar interface com áreas administrativas e assistenciais para otimizar fluxos e integrações sistêmicas;
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento com gestores e diretoria.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência comprovada mínima de 3 anos na função de Coordenação ou Supervisão de TI;
  • Domínio em TOTVS – módulo Saúde (implantação, suporte e gestão);
  • Vivência com sistemas de gestão hospitalar ou clínicas;
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura, redes, servidores e segurança da informação;
  • Capacidade de liderar equipes técnicas e gerir demandas simultâneas;
  • Boa comunicação, proatividade e orientação a resultados.

Atitudes Fundamentais

  • Alfabetização Digital e Fluência Tecnológica;
  • Comunicação Multicanal e Influência Positiva;
  • Gestão de Tempo, Energia e Produtividade Consciente;
  • Inteligência Emocional e Autogestão;
  • Adaptabilidade e Aprendizado Contínuo.

Habilidades Comportamentais

  • Responsabilidade e Comprometimento;
  • Autoconhecimento e Inteligência Emocional;
  • Proatividade e Iniciativa;
  • Flexibilidade e Adaptabilidade;
  • Comunicação Clara e Empática;
  • Foco em Organização, Planejamento e Entrega.

Salário/Benefícios

  • R$ 6.000,00 (CLT – Presencial)
  • Benefícios
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Ticket Refeição;
  • Seguro de Vida em Grupo;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Plano de Saúde.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência anterior na área da saúde (hospitais, clínicas, laboratórios, etc.);
  • Certificações na área de tecnologia (ITIL, COBIT, ISO 27001) ou gestão de TI;
  • Conhecimento em gestão de projetos e implantação de sistemas.
  • Outras Informações
  • Horário de trabalho: 09h às 18h
  • Regime de trabalho: CLT Presencial

title: Design Director, UI/UX & Brand
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We are hiring a Design Director - a visionary leader with a strong design background who thrives in driving high-quality design execution across various platforms as well as managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

This role requires deep experience in branded UI/UX design. You’re a senior‑level design lead that can independently own multiple web design engagements simultaneously. Navigating client feedback and pushback is an everyday muscle you successfully work with. You can show deep experience in being able to thread the needle between game‑changing UI, conversion‑oriented UX, and technical feasibility, all on a tight timeline. Clients are consistently impressed by your knowledge of e‑commerce heuristics and how you combine that with unique and branded design. You love working with developers to understand how to make your ideas come to life and sell clients on design solutions and tradeoffs they have to make to complete engagements on‑time.

You pride yourself on being able to effortlessly spin up a new brand design system for a client that feels differentiated, elevated, and informed by your strategic market analysis. You have consistently merged business thinking with exceptional visual craft into scalable brand identities that work across paid media, retention, web, social, and packaging.

In addition to your individual contributor responsibilities, you will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e‑commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.

This role requires a balance of creativity, business strategy, and leadership in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment. You’ll work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure the alignment of design goals with broader business objectives. Your ability to drive creative strategy and manage multiple projects with precision will be essential to your success. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities:

  • Lead 1‑3 UI/UX engagements as needed, focusing on creating branded e‑commerce websites.

  • Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.

  • Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.

  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.

  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.

Management Responsibilities:

  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 2‑4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.

  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.

  • Ensure high‑quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.

  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.

  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.

You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You:

  • 3‑6+ years of senior‑level web design experience with e‑commerce companies, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in responsive web design.

  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.

  • Self‑motivated, proactive, and detail‑oriented with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.

  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.

  • Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.

  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.

  • Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.

  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.

  • Bonus: Familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in‑office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Engineering Manager for Sustaining Engineering passionate about open source software, Linux and cloud computing. Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, the growing international software company behind Ubuntu.
Sustaining Engineering is a business critical team that continuously improves various open source software by resolving software defects reported by customers. Software stack includes everything from the kernel all the way up to the user space applications and IaaS platforms. This position leads one of our regional teams and is one of several managers, who report directly to the global Director of Sustaining Engineering.
Our customers build large-scale mission critical infrastructure and application solutions on Ubuntu and open source from Canonical. While not actively developing products, Sustaining Engineering, as part of Support Engineering, solves problems for the customer and for the benefit of the wider Open Source community. This team is well staffed with experts in every time zone and, while the work can be challenging sometimes, the team is resourced to ensure a good work-life balance and ongoing development of each team member.
As an engineering manager in the Sustaining Engineering team, your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, making valuable contributions, and generally having a great experience at Canonical. Technical leadership and a solid background in software development are a must, so that you are able to help your team members grow professionally. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
Location: This is a globally remote role, unless specified otherwise.
The role entails

  • Manage and lead a distributed team of engineers
  • Hire, coach, mentor, provide feedback and career development guidance to your team
  • Manage & measure key performance indicators (KPIs), and training
  • Support timely delivery of bug fixes, patches, and other technical solutions to address business needs in a variety of technology fields, including but not limited to Ubuntu, OpenStack, Ceph, Kubernetes, Juju & MAAS
  • Demonstrate the very best of Canonical in customer interactions
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Advocate and advance modern software development practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company value
  • Collaborate with other teams in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 10% for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • Professional software delivery experience using C, C++, Go, Python, or similar
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • Leadership experience displaying ability to organise and prioritise complex problem resolution and bug fixes
  • Experience with version control systems such as git
  • Experience with debugging tools such as gdb, crash or other
  • Demonstrated strong commitment to testing methodologies and maintainable code quality
  • Excellent communication skills in the English language, both verbal and written
  • Experience with Linux, with a preference towards Ubuntu
  • Experience with Open Source and Open Source Business Models
  • People management experience in a support organisation is a strong plus
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Research Fellow-3 role at Inside Higher Ed .

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will participate in the Neurodegeneration Computational Fellows Training Program (NDCF) at Howard University, developing and applying computational skills in neuroscience research. Under the mentorship of host labs, the fellow will contribute to analyzing datasets related to neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, or traumatic brain injury (TBI), advancing the understanding of disease mechanisms. This role supports the program’s mission to train researchers in advanced mathematics, data analysis, and bioinformatics for neurodegeneration research.

Supervisory Authority

This position has no supervisory authority. The fellow will work directly under the supervision of a principal investigator or mentor in a host lab affiliated with the NDCF program, receiving guidance on research tasks and computational training.

Nature And Scope

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will engage in interdisciplinary research within a host lab at Howard University or a partner institution, such as NIH/NINDS, focusing on computational approaches to neurodegeneration. The fellow will gain hands-on experience analyzing neurophysiological, genomic, or imaging data using tools like Python, R, or machine learning frameworks. The fellow will collaborate with researchers, other fellows, and faculty, participating in lab meetings and NDCF symposia. The role is designed to support professional growth by developing skills in data analysis and contributing to research publications. External opportunities may include presenting at conferences or collaborating with partners in the Neurodegeneration Challenge Network (NDCN) under the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assist in analyzing datasets (e.g., MRI, genomic, or microbiome data) using computational tools under the guidance of a mentor, identifying patterns or biomarkers in neurodegenerative diseases.
  • Learn and apply statistical or machine learning methods to support research on disease mechanisms, following lab protocols.
  • Support data processing tasks, such as image analysis or sequence alignment, using provided software or scripts.
  • Prepare research summaries and present findings at NDCF symposia, lab meetings, or external conferences.
  • Contribute to team discussions, collaborating with lab members to integrate computational and experimental findings.
  • Maintain accurate records of research activities and adhere to ethical standards in data handling and reporting.

Core Competencies

  • Computational Aptitude: Basic familiarity with programming (e.g., Python, R) or data analysis tools, with a strong interest in learning advanced computational techniques.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to approach complex datasets with curiosity and apply structured methods to derive meaningful insights under mentorship.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams, including researchers, students, and faculty.
  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication to present research progress and engage with scientific audiences.
  • Adaptability: Eagerness to acquire new skills and adapt to evolving research tools and methodologies in a training-focused environment.

Minimum Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in neuroscience, biology, computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Experience: Some exposure to programming, data analysis, or neuroscience research through coursework, internships, or personal projects. No prior expertise required.
  • Skills: Basic familiarity with computational tools (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, or command-line interfaces) or a strong interest in learning these skills. Introductory knowledge of statistics or data visualization is a plus.
  • Other: Demonstrated interest in neurodegeneration research and the ability to work collaboratively under mentorship guidance.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

title: Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação
description:
Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação

A Fundação de Apoio à Escola Técnica (Faetec), vinculada à Secretaria de Estado de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, iniciou nesta quinta-feira (26) a distribuição do vale-alimentação a todos os funcionários da Rede. A partir de agora, servidores de carreira e de contratos temporários podem contar com um cartão com valor mensal que pode chegar a R$660,00.
Os funcionários com carga horária de 20h semanais irão receber o valor mensal de R$330,00. Para os profissionais que trabalham 40h e 60h será depositado a quantia de R$660,00. O cartão poderá ser utilizado em estabelecimentos parceiros e já está sendo distribuído a todos os 5.162 funcionários, que atuam em mais de 120 unidades da Rede, em 63 municípios do Estado.
Além da Presidente da Faetec, Caroline Alves, o Secretário de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, Mauro Azevedo Neto, esteve presente na entrega do primeiro vale-alimentação a um servidor da Rede. Ele acredita que o benefício chega para reconhecer os esforços do servidor.
“Sempre que tínhamos reuniões, a Carol trazia essa pauta como valorização do servidor, então é um prazer estar aqui no momento dessa entrega. Sou filho de professora da rede estadual de educação e sei como os auxílios aos servidores e a valorização do servidor são importantes. Na secretaria já fui assistente, assessor, chefe de gabinete, subsecretário e hoje estou como secretário, então sei que são os servidores que constroem a secretaria e a Faetec. O governador está sendo um parceiro nas pautas de educação, a gente sabe que o orçamento é curto, mas sempre que valoriza o servidor, ele é bem gasto”, declarou o S ecretário.
Os servidores e temporários recebem o vale-alimentação com o benefício referente aos meses de setembro e outubro. A medida não só reconhece e valoriza os profissionais que atuam nas unidades da Faetec, mas contribui para um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e motivador.
Para Caroline Alves, presidente da Faetec, a entrega do vale-alimentação só foi possível graças ao empenho dos próprios funcionários, que se dedicam diariamente para que a Faetec continue sendo uma instituição de excelência. A gestora aproveitou a ocasião para agradecer a parceria da Secretaria.
“Essa é uma causa dos servidores de muitos anos e é uma construção que estamos fazendo juntos, sempre tenho esse cuidado de ouvir o outro, dialogar e construir isso junto. Eu acredito que essa entrega é importante para a nossa Rede e não posso deixar de mencionar o secretário que nos ajudou, abriu caminhos e deu suporte nessa construção”, concluiu a presidente da Faetec.

title: Supervisor de Engenharia Clínica
description:
Join to apply for the Supervisor de Engenharia Clínica role at e.Quality Soluções e Engenharia LTDA

O Supervisor de Engenharia Clínica é o líder técnico e gestor das operações de engenharia clínica em sua unidade de atuação, assegurando a gestão segura, eficaz e economicamente responsável do parque tecnológico de equipamentos médico-hospitalares. Ele garante a excelência na execução dos serviços, a conformidade com as regulamentações, a otimização dos recursos e o desenvolvimento da equipe técnica, atuando como um pilar fundamental para a satisfação do cliente e a qualidade do serviço.

  • Gestão Operacional e Conformidade: Assegurar a implementação e a manutenção contínua dos processos definidos no Plano de Gerenciamento de Tecnologias em Saúde (PGTS) da unidade, utilizando os sistemas e ferramentas designados. Garantir a total conformidade das operações e documentações com a legislação vigente, normas técnicas (ex: NBR IEC 60601, ISO/IEC 17025 quando aplicável) e regulamentações (ANVISA, INMETRO). Revisar e garantir a organização e controle de todos os documentos relacionados aos processos no sistema de gestão (ex: DOO), assegurando sua rastreabilidade e fácil acesso. Preparar e organizar a documentação e processos referentes à acreditação hospitalar da unidade, montando apresentações para auditorias e liderando o processo para o sucesso da certificação.
  • Liderança e Desenvolvimento de Equipe: Supervisionar e orientar diariamente as atividades dos técnicos de engenharia clínica, garantindo a qualidade e eficiência na execução dos serviços de manutenção, calibração e ensaios. Acompanhar a performance individual e da equipe, provendo feedback construtivo e participando ativamente do desenvolvimento técnico dos colaboradores. Garantir a replicação e adesão da equipe aos treinamentos ministrados pela empresa, bem como promover o compartilhamento de conhecimento técnico com a equipe e com o corpo assistencial do cliente.
  • Gestão da Manutenção e Otimização do Parque Tecnológico: Garantir a resolutividade das solicitações de manutenção corretiva, supervisionando o diagnóstico, a cotação de peças/acessórios e a proposição de soluções eficazes. Supervisionar e acompanhar a execução da manutenção planejada (preventiva e preditiva) dos equipamentos, assegurando o cumprimento dos cronogramas e a emissão dos laudos e certificados. Assegurar o correto preenchimento e registro de todas as atividades no sistema de gestão da manutenção (SGM), desde a abertura da solicitação até a avaliação do serviço prestado. Elaborar pareceres técnicos e laudos de obsolescência de equipamentos, baseando-se no histórico e normativas, para subsidiar a avaliação do parque tecnológico do cliente.
  • Gestão de Fornecedores e Contratos: Supervisionar os serviços realizados por terceiros e a execução de contratos dentro da unidade, por meio da análise das ordens de serviço externas. Avaliar o custo-benefício de contratos e serviços avulsos de terceiros, propondo otimizações ou alternativas. Relacionar e controlar pedidos de materiais, acessórios e peças de reposição para garantir a eficiência e a continuidade do funcionamento dos Equipamentos Médico-Hospitalares (EMH), gerenciando o estoque no SGM.
  • Análise de Dados e Relatórios: Confeccionar relatórios técnicos detalhados de manutenções corretivas, preventivas, calibrações e ensaios de segurança elétrica. Realizar análises críticas para apresentar ao cliente o status dos equipamentos, sugerindo soluções técnicas e economicamente viáveis para otimizar a gestão do parque tecnológico. Manter o coordenador imediato informado sobre o andamento dos trabalhos e desafios, buscando soluções e alinhando estratégias em reuniões e contatos diários.
  • Relacionamento com o Cliente e Expansão de Serviço: Atuar como ponto de contato técnico principal com a equipe e gestão do hospital cliente para assuntos relacionados à engenharia clínica. Realizar cotações de equipamentos e coordenar demonstrações, conforme a necessidade do cliente, com o objetivo de ampliar o escopo de serviços e soluções oferecidas.
  • Gestão de Ativos e Recursos: Zelar pela conservação e organização de todos os equipamentos e ferramentas disponibilizados para sua função, solicitando reposição quando necessário. Executar outras tarefas pertinentes ao cargo, delegadas pelo coordenador de engenharia clínica ou superior imediato.

Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Background

  • The Cargo Supervisor will exhibit a high standard of leadership, supervisory and safety behaviors and will ensure that all aspects of Cargo and Cargo Utility systems operations and supervision are carried out effectively. Delegated tasks will be monitored and controlled formally and effectively.
  • Equivalent to Ballast Control Operator (BCO) as per Res. A.1079(28) Reg. 6.4

Authority

  • The Cargo Supervisor assumes delegated authority for marine activities such as cargo loading and offloading and cargo utilities and maintenance. He or she will work with the Cargo Superintendent and the OIM as required where the safety of the crew and vessel is concerned. Work authority is delegated to competent personnel as appropriate.

Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards

  • 1) Cargo Operations
  • 1 Prepare to Start Marine and Cargo Operations
  • 2 Startup Marine and Cargo Operations
  • 3 Monitor and Maintain Marine and Cargo Operations
  • 4 Prepare and shutdown Marine and Cargo Operations
  • 5 Contribute to Tank Entry, Inspection and Maintenance Activities
  • 2) Manage And Supervise Effectively
  • 1 Demonstrate leadership in technical and safety issues.
  • 2 Liaise effectively with all relevant onshore and offshore departments.
  • 3 Delegate authority having due regard for competence and verify effective close out of tasks.
  • 4 Promote training and competency assurance throughout the department in line with Company goals for the Unit.
  • 5 Promote safety awareness and application of the Management System regarding immediate safety of personnel (PTW/Risk assessments/inspections).
  • 6 Ensure timely and effective close-out of relevant survey and audit action items.
  • 7 Encourage and support all department personnel to achieve training and competency targets and plan for appropriate time allocation for this area of work.
  • 8 Ensure timely and effective contributions to reporting and investigation of all incidents where required.
  • 3) Contribute To The Control Of Critical Situations And Respond To Emergencies
  • 1 Developing critical situations (operational, weather, equipment failure, leaks, fires personnel etc.) are identified and positive action is taken to limit escalation and to maintain control using applied policies or procedures or initiative
  • 2 Manage emergency response with due regard for safety of personnel, FSO/FPSO and environment
  • 3 Demonstrate knowledge and awareness of potential emergency scenarios.
  • 4 Contribute to the effective de-brief and analysis of exercises.
  • 4) Monitor And Maintain Pollution Control Measures
  • 1 Controlled process discharges from area of responsibility to the environment are within prescribed limits
  • 2 Unplanned discharges are identified, halted where possible, and reported according to policy, procedure and regulation.
  • 3 Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are dealt with according to the correct procedure.
  • 4 Controlled process discharges from area of responsibility to the environment are within prescribed limits
  • 5) Emergency Response
  • 1 Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill).
  • 2 Demonstrate competence in Emergency Response drills and exercises.

Recruitment Only-Generic Functional Competencies

Offshore - Perform Lifeboat Maintenance

Offshore - Manage Supply and Crew Boat Operations

Offshore - Monitor Weather Condition

Offshore - Plant and vessel knowledge

Offshore - Crane operations, rigging and lifting operations

Offshore - Safety Management - HOD

Offshore - Define Hull Integrity Management

Offshore - Tanker Terminal

Offshore - Manage Cargo Export

Pre-hire Qualifications and Experience

  • Minimum qualifications as per STCW II/2 Chief Officer of ships of 3000gt or more.
  • 3 years Crude Oil tankers experience (VLCC preferable) as OOW (Officer on Watch) Chief Officer experience desirable.
  • Previous FPSO experience would be an advantage.
  • Use and experience with Loading Computer Software.
  • Proficiency in English at a minimum of B1 level according to the CEFR international standard.
  • Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore

  • Willingness to travel within the region, up to 50%, as required.

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. Ela substitui Ana Paula Magri, que havia sido a primeira pessoa brasileira a ocupar o comando da empresa no País.

Com isso, Danielle estará à frente do negócio que, no Brasil, comercializa as marcas Eau Thermal Avène (marca francesa especializada em dermocosméticos e uma das líderes em venda na Europa), Ducray (também francesa e focada em alta ciência e medicalização) e Darrow Laboratório (marca brasileira de dermocosméticos para pele oleosa e que, segundo a empresa faz sucesso entre a GenZ e começou a ser exportada para outros países da América Latina recentemente).

Danielle trabalhou como CMO do Grupo Petrópolis de setembro de 2022 a setembro de 2023, mas antes disso teve um longo histórico na Avon.

Na companhia de beleza, onde trabalhou por 12 anos, ocupou os cargos de CMO no Brasil e vice-presidente de marketing global. Imediatamente antes da Avon, também teve um histórico de 16 anos na P&G, onde também lidou com a categoria de saúde e beleza, tendo seu último cargo por lá sido o de presidente de Health and Beauty Care, no Canadá.

Metas estabelecidas

Há dois anos, a filial brasileira da Pierre Fabre – cujo faturamento global gira em torno de € 2,8 bilhões – ocupava a 10ª posição no mapa da companhia. E a então CEO, Ana Paula, afirmava que o objetivo era que o Brasil subisse cinco posições nesse ranking, dobrando o tamanho dos negócios até 2026.

Na cidade de Areal, no Rio de Janeiro, está instalada a única fábrica da Pierre Fabre fora da França. E desde 2018 o País também abriga o Brazilian Innovation Center (BIC), focado no desenvolvimento de produtos para a população local.

Quem somos?

Smart Hospital: Transformando a saúde com inovação. Somos líderes em construção, reforma e operação de infraestrutura hospitalar, pioneiros em modernizar hospitais por meio de parcerias público-privadas. Em parceria com o Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar, o maior hospital de emergência da América Latina, estamos redefinindo os padrões de atendimento em saúde.

O que buscamos?

Um profissional que consiga ser um gestor de projetos eficaz, garantindo que a obra:

  • Seja segura e legal.
  • Seja concluída dentro do orçamento e do prazo.
  • Minimize o transtorno causado pela obra.

As principais funções do síndico no contexto de obras são:

  • Garantir a Segurança e a Conformidade Legal
    Exigir o cumprimento da NBR 16.280 e do regimento interno do condomínio em todas as reformas, seja nas áreas comuns ou nas unidades privativas.
    Zelar pela conservação e segurança da edificação (Art. 1.348, V, do Código Civil), responsabilizando‑se por qualquer dano causado por negligência na fiscalização.
  • Autorizações e Documentação
    Analisar e aprovar o Plano de Reforma detalhado antes de qualquer obra ser iniciada.
    Exigir a Anotação de Responsabilidade Técnica (ART) ou o Registro de Responsabilidade Técnica (RRT), assinados por engenheiro ou arquiteto habilitado, garantindo que um profissional seja o responsável técnico pela obra.
    Manter a documentação da obra arquivada.

Requisitos

  • I. Requisitos Técnicos e Legais
    • Conhecimento da NBR 16.280: É obrigatório que o síndico conheça a fundo a norma que trata da Gestão de Reformas em Edificações.
    • Noções Básicas de Construção Civil: capacidade de ler e interpretar plantas simples, entender orçamentos, cronogramas e etapas.
    • Domínio do Código Civil (Obras): conhecer os quóruns de aprovação de obras (Artigos 1.341 a 1.343).
    • Habilidade em Análise de Documentos: analisar e arquivar corretamente ARTs, RRTs, laudos de inspeção, contratos e garantias.
    • Gestão de Contratos: conhecer aspectos essenciais de contratos de empreitada/serviço.
  • II. Requisitos de Gestão e Administrativos
    • Organização e Método: gerar e controlar documentação, orçamentos e cronogramas.
    • Rigor Financeiro: elaborar previsões orçamentárias detalhadas e controlar desembolsos.
    • Planejamento Estratégico: priorizar obras de manutenção preventiva e planejar projetos de longo prazo.
    • Transparência: garantir clareza na seleção de fornecedores e prestação de contas.
  • III. Requisitos Comportamentais (Perfil)
    • Liderança e Proatividade: contratar consultorias, realizar cotações e manter preventivas.
    • Capacidade de Comunicação: informar moradores sobre impacto e dialogar com empreiteira.
    • Negociação e Imparcialidade: negociar contratos e prazos, mediar conflitos entre vizinhos.
    • Resolução de Problemas (Crise): lidar com atrasos, problemas estruturais e acidentes.

description:
Software Engineering Manager (Backend SaaS)

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors.

We are hiring an engineering manager to lead the reboot of our Landscape systems management solution for Ubuntu. Ubuntu is growing rapidly in the enterprise, with estates expanding from cloud, to bare metal servers, to vSphere clusters, and of course desktops and devices. Landscape helps manage policy, compliance, patch management, and access control across large estates.

We have a system that serves thousands of deployments, and we want to give it a fresh vision. This role is the critical engineering leadership role for that mission.

Engineering managers at Canonical bring both technical and management skills. You will work closely with product managers and produce an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals. You will grow a team of engineers, collaborate with other engineering and business teams, and provide periodic updates about successes and areas of improvement.

As an engineering manager you must be technically strong, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage, helping them grow as engineers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and lead a team of engineers in your region
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback, and hands‑on career development
  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles and directly contribute toward your team's goals
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholders
  • Lead modern, agile software development practices
  • Ensure a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organization
  • Build automated, highly reliable image delivery, testing and publication pipelines
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open‑source community and commercial partners
  • Work from home with global travel 4–6 weeks per year for internal and external events

Valued Skills and Experience

  • You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high‑quality software
  • You have experience and commitment to agile development methodologies
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent degree in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • Software development experience in Python or Golang
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Practical experience with Linux system administration

What We Offer

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Canonical is an equal‑opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
Sempre estamos em busca de talentos para posições operacionais no nosso GSE , sendo as principais:

  • MECÂNICO
Responsável por atuar na manutenção preventiva/corretiva de equipamentos da linha pesada, com foco em motores a diesel e equipamentos pesados.
  • ELETRICISTA
Responsável pelo reparo e manutenções preventivas em sistemas e componentes elétricos, eletrônicos voltado para área automotiva aeroportuário, exemplo: linha Diesel.
  • SERRALHEIRO
Responsável por reparos estruturais com serviços de solda e serralheria em equipamentos de atendimento aeroportuário.
  • PINTOR
Responsável pela preparação, pinturas e reparos em equipamentos de atendimento aeroportuário.
  • AUXILIAR DE MANUTENÇÃO
Auxilia na manutenção em serviços de reparos mecânicos, elétricos, hidráulicos e borracharia.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Ensino médio completo; formação técnica na área relacionada;
  • Conhecimento sólido em sistemas mecânicos, hidráulicos e elétricos de veículos pesados;
  • Habilidade para diagnosticar problemas e desenvolver soluções eficazes;
  • Capacidade de ler e interpretar manuais técnicos, esquemas e diagramas;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e trabalho em equipe;
  • Compromisso com a qualidade, segurança e eficiência no trabalho;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos e horas extras conforme necessário;
  • Experiência anterior com manutenção de equipamentos de apoio em solo aeroportuário;
  • Familiaridade com as normas de segurança e regulamentos operacionais de aeroportos.
Para estas posições, nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura em bipedestação para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, rotação e flexão do tronco, esforço físico, locomoção e deambulação para realização de manutenções e atendimento de serviços emergenciais.
Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para inspeções, manutenções e condução de veículo a serviço da empresa (atividade regulamentada pelo CTB – código de trânsito brasileiro) e percepção auditiva para atendimento telefônico, aos colaboradores, identificação de ruídos de anormalidades em peças e equipamentos e identificação de sinais sonoros emergenciais em vias públicas e em áreas operacionais.
Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de desenhos técnicos, dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.

Realizar a limpeza e conservação de peixes e frutos do mar preparando variadas refeições da cozinha oriental, conforme sortimento da empresa, verificando e garantindo a qualidade, frescor, aparência, exposição e organização da área de vendas para atendimento dos nossos clientes.

  • Realizar a higienização do local de armazenamento, garantir o correto acondicionamento das mercadorias e verificar a qualidade e validade dos itens em estoque.

Supervisor de Engenharia Clínica

O Técnico de Engenharia Clínica é o profissional técnico responsável por assegurar o funcionamento contínuo, seguro e eficaz do parque tecnológico de equipamentos médico-hospitalares. Ele executa manutenções preventivas, corretivas, calibrações e ensaios, garantindo a disponibilidade dos equipamentos para o atendimento ao paciente, em conformidade com as normas técnicas e os procedimentos internos. Sua atuação é fundamental para a segurança do paciente e a eficiência operacional da instituição de saúde.

  • Execução de Manutenções e Intervenções Técnicas: Realizar manutenções corretivas nos equipamentos médico-hospitalares, desde a abertura do chamado até a identificação da falha e a intervenção técnica, visando restaurar todas as funcionalidades e retomar a operação de forma segura. Executar manutenções planejadas/programadas (preventivas e preditivas), utilizando padrões e simuladores adequados, para garantir que os equipamentos estejam sempre aptos para uso seguro, com laudos e certificados válidos. Realizar calibrações e ensaios de segurança elétrica nos equipamentos, seguindo os procedimentos e normas técnicas aplicáveis, para assegurar a precisão e a segurança dos dispositivos.
  • Gestão de Equipamentos e Controle Patrimonial: Realizar o controle e rastreio de equipamentos por meio de rondas diárias, verificando o estado geral, a localização e a condição de uso, para garantir sua conservação e disponibilidade. Acompanhar o recebimento de novos equipamentos e insumos, conferindo notas fiscais e a contagem dos produtos, e testando os equipamentos para verificar sua aptidão para o uso. Preservar e zelar pelos equipamentos e ferramentas disponibilizados para sua função, mantendo-os organizados, limpos e conservados, e solicitando novas ferramentas ao supervisor quando necessário, demonstrando cuidado com o patrimônio da empresa.
  • Documentação e Registro no Sistema: Alimentar o sistema de gestão da manutenção (SGM), realizando a abertura de Ordens de Serviço (OS) e preenchendo detalhadamente as ações executadas, peças utilizadas e observações, para garantir um histórico preciso e completo do equipamento. Assegurar a correta emissão de laudos e certificados de acordo com as normativas vigentes, após a execução das manutenções e calibrações.
  • Acompanhamento e Suporte: Manter o supervisor imediato informado sobre o andamento dos trabalhos e os desafios encontrados, buscando soluções e alinhando as atividades diariamente. Acompanhar as atividades de serviços realizados por terceiros dentro da unidade, por meio da análise de ordens de serviço externas, para garantir o registro e histórico completo dos equipamentos. Executar outras tarefas pertinentes ao cargo que venham a ser delegadas pelo supervisor de engenharia clínica.
  • Relacionamento e Otimização: Realizar cotações de equipamentos e coordenar demonstrações conforme a necessidade do cliente, através do contato com fornecedores, com o objetivo de apoiar a ampliação dos serviços e soluções oferecidas.

title: Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel
description:
Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open‑source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT.

Our customers include the world’s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring Software Engineering Managers to lead technical teams in the various aspects of the delivery and ongoing support and maintenance of all Linux kernels provided by the Ubuntu Linux distribution. As the Linux kernel itself is now quite broad, so are the technical domains and challenges involved, ranging from integrating support for bleeding‑edge hardware into the latest Ubuntu kernels, to expanding the range of execution environments available to Ubuntu, to the complexities inherent in applying the latest fixes and updates to all of the >100 Ubuntu Linux kernels under active support during our Stable Release Update cycles.

This role would suit either an experienced manager of high‑performing software development teams, or a very proficient technical lead who is excited to take on a management responsibility. You will need to be passionate about Linux and aspire to be an integral part in its distribution to millions of users worldwide.

The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of software engineers in your geographic region in distinct aspects of delivery of all Linux kernels for the Ubuntu Linux distribution.
  • Taking ownership of particular aspects of Ubuntu Linux which can include but not be limited to:
    • Working with silicon or cloud partners to implement Linux kernels optimised for their execution environments.
    • Ensuring Ubuntu Linux is able to run on a wide range of diverse hardware platforms.
    • Definition and execution of the stringent quality control standards expected by the Ubuntu user community.
    • Mitigation of the latest security threats and exploits to the Linux kernel.
    • Strong process automation as it pertains to the build, test, and delivery of the Linux kernel.
  • Engagement with other teams at Canonical, the open source community and commercial partners.

What we are looking for in you

  • Significant programming experience in C, with Python, Golang, or other like languages is also highly regarded.
  • Substantial experience with operating system kernel internals and concepts, Linux would be highly regarded but not essential.
  • Demonstrated experience managing or leading a team of software engineers.
  • Ability to coordinate between multiple distinct teams of differing technical focus to achieve common goals.
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git.
  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded.
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging.
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSPs, and other low‑level system engineering.
  • Solid background in driving CI/CD and process automation initiatives.
  • Prior public involvement with an open source project.

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Seniority level: Mid‑Senior level

Employment type: Full‑time

Job function: Engineering and Information Technology

    • Documentar e mapear sistemas, integrações, dependências e capabilities.

    • Garantir que processos, integrações, sistemas e dados conversem entre si.
    • Criar visão integrada: Processos → Dados → Aplicações → Integrações.
    • Suportar o Architecture Board com evidências técnicas e funcionais.

  • Testes, Cutover e Go-Live
    • Garantir que o TO-BE esteja integrado aos roteiros de teste.
    • Validar que o processo configurado = testado = carregado = pronto para operação.
    • Suportar mock runs e readiness com base nas jornadas modeladas.

Requisitos

  • Vivência prática com LeanIX como ferramenta de arquitetura empresarial.
  • Experiência em programas SAP S/4HANA, preferencialmente em Utilities (IS-U).

description:
Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.

For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.

Job Description

Job Overview:

Provide emergency and routine medical care to workers on board.

We are currently exploring potential candidates for an upcoming role at McDermott. While this position is not yet open for active recruitment, we want to connect with talented individuals who may be interested in future projects with us. Qualifications

  • Doctor Degree in Medicine and registration with the Regional Medical Council (CRM).
  • Certifications in advanced life support, such as Advanced Cardiac Life Support (ACLS) and Advanced Trauma Life Support (ATLS)

description:
SELECIONADOR - RECRUTAMENTO E SELEÇÃO - BASE ADMINISTRATIVA

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Realizar processos de Recrutamento e Seleção para profissionais de todas as categorias, obedecendo aos métodos adotados pela Instituição.

Seu principal objetivo é aplicar métodos de Engenharia de Produção, otimização de processos e logística (ex: Lean) para garantir o fluxo eficiente, o controle estatístico da qualidade, o abastecimento adequado e a máxima produtividade do enxoval hospitalar (limpo e sujo), contribuindo diretamente para a qualidade da assistência e a prevenção de infecções hospitalares.

Dia a Dia

  • Gerenciar os custos operacionais (OPEX), aplicando a análise da causa raiz (Root Cause Analysis) para reduzir perdas (extravios/danos) e otimizar o ciclo de vida do enxoval.
  • Elaborar a escala de trabalho e o cronograma de férias dos colaboradores.
  • Elaborar e gerenciar o cumprimento do Plano de Ação Setorial, desenvolvendo e monitorando
  • Indicadores-Chave de Desempenho (KPIs) como Taxa de Perda, Custo por Peça Processada e Nível de Serviço.
  • Aplicar os Manuais de Boas Práticas estabelecidos, o Manual de Acreditação ONA 2014 e o RAG -
  • Requisitos de Apoio à Gestão.
  • Prover a gerência de informações por meio de relatórios analíticos e dashboards que subsidiem tomadas de decisões estratégicas e baseadas em dados (data-driven).
  • Zelar pelo cumprimento do contrato de Interação de Processos.
  • Avaliar a equipe quanto ao desempenho, assiduidade, pontualidade e disciplina.
  • Executar outras tarefas correlatas à área.

Local de trabalho

Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar. Endereço: Praça da República, 111, Centro, Rio de Janeiro

Horário

8h às 18h de segunda a quinta-feira | 8h às 17h na sexta-feira

Requisitos

  • Ensino Superior Completo. Altamente desejável em Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia de Processos, Logística ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável experiência prévia em cargos de supervisão ou liderança, obrigatoriamente em lavanderias hospitalares ou em setor de Rouparia dentro de hospitais.
  • Conhecimento em Ambiente Hospitalar: ter familiaridade com as particularidades do fluxo de enxoval e normas de segurança e higiene (CCIH).
  • Habilidade em gestão de equipes, liderança e comunicação.
  • Capacidade de organização, planejamento e resolução de problemas.

O Que Vamos Amar Se Você Tiver

  • Pós-graduação em áreas relacionadas à Gestão Hospitalar, Qualidade ou áreas afins.
  • Vivência ou Conhecimento em metodologias de Melhoria Contínua (PDCA, DMAIC) e ferramentas de Qualidade (Ex: 5S, Six Sigma).
  • Habilidade intermediária/avançada em Excel/Power BI para modelagem e análise de dados.
  • Conhecimento técnico sobre tipos de enxoval, controle de estoque e ciclo de vida da roupa hospitalar.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão da qualidade.

Benefícios

title: Primary Care Physician - BC Family Medicine
description:
Overview

Primary Care Physician - BC Family Medicine at Community Health Centers of the Central Coast, Inc. (CHC). Reports To: Chief Medical Officer. FLSA Status: Exempt. Wage Range: $9,230.77 - $11,220.06 bi-weekly.

Summary: Under the direction of the Chief Medical Officer, but with independent responsibility for professional results, the Physician provides primary healthcare services for CHC and performs related work as required. CHC aims to provide the highest quality of total care to the patient population; employees are expected to be professional, punctual, maintain regular attendance, cooperative, organized, and enthusiastic.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  • Secure and evaluate a patient''s health history and record findings in a systematic, accurate, and succinct manner.
  • Perform physical assessments and discriminate between normal and abnormal findings.
  • Provide routine physical examinations, diagnostic services, and treatment of illnesses and emergencies.
  • Adhere to high ethical standards and assure quality of care for all patients.
  • Share on-call duties with other medical staff as indicated.
  • Elicit and record information about patient medical history; examine patients to determine general physical condition.
  • Order or execute tests, analyses, and diagnostic images; analyze reports and findings to diagnose conditions.
  • Administer or prescribe treatments and drugs; inoculate and vaccinate patients; advise on diet, hygiene, and disease prevention.
  • Report births, deaths, and outbreaks to governmental authorities; refer patients to specialists when needed.
  • Perform minor surgeries and conduct physicals for school admissions, job considerations, or insurance eligibility.
  • Assist the Chief Medical Officer in establishing medical policies and education programs; participate in care coordination and policy development as required.
  • Share supervisory responsibilities of the nurse practitioner with the Clinical Director as required; work within privileges and protocols established by the CMO.
  • Participate in committees as requested; adhere to safety and infection control policies; provide age-appropriate care across patient populations.
  • Maintain HIPAA-compliant, confidential communications; participate in patient population management with cultural sensitivity and appropriate local resources.
  • Coordinate with the Care Team to arrange appropriate services and support patient goals; contribute to quality improvement using evidence-based practices.

Supervisory Responsibilities

May supervise mid-level providers at the direction of the Chief Medical Officer.

Qualifications

  • Education: Medical Doctor (M.D.) or Doctor of Osteopathy (D.O.) from an accredited medical school.
  • Residency: Completion in Family Practice, Internal Medicine, OB/GYN, or Pediatrics; board certified or board eligible.
  • Licenses and Certifications: Current, unrestricted Physician and Surgeon license in California; current DEA license; ACLS for FP/IM; PALS for Pediatrics; BLS (all specialties).
  • Continuing education: Maintains current knowledge through CME and participation in relevant medical societies.
  • Language Skills: English required; Spanish bilingual desirable.

Education And/or Experience

As listed under Qualifications above.

Other Requirements

  • Ability to perform essential duties and accommodate reasonable accommodations as needed.
  • Physical demands and work environment as described below may apply: willing to work flexible hours, occasional travel to other clinic sites.

Note: This job description contains general information and is not an exhaustive listing of duties and responsibilities. EEO statements and other legally required notices remain in effect.

title: MOÇO DE MÁQUINAS
description:
Vaga de Moço de Máquinas

Descrição:

Estamos em busca de um Moço de Máquinas para auxiliar na operação e manutenção de equipamentos.

Responsabilidades:

  • Nesta função, o moço de máquinas opera variados tipos de máquinas e sistemas de embarcações, tais como geradores de energia elétrica, sistemas separadores de água e óleo, caldeiras, bombas de carga e sistemas de água e esgoto sanitário.
  • Limpa tanques de óleo de carga. Aciona gerador de emergência.
  • Drena tanques de combustível e desgaseifica o tanque. Realiza o abastecimento das máquinas. Procede às sondagens diárias e anota dados dos equipamentos no bandalho de máquina;
  • Auxiliar na preparação e operação de máquinas;
  • Realizar manutenção básica em equipamentos;
  • Monitorar o funcionamento das máquinas durante a operação;
  • Colaborar na limpeza e organização do ambiente de trabalho;
  • Realiza manutenção preventiva e corretiva da praça de máquinas, transporta cargas, realiza manutenção preventiva e corretiva do convés, equipamentos e aparelhos;
  • Operar máquinas;
  • Executar serviços operacionais no convés;
  • Realiza manutenção preventiva da praça de máquinas, lubrificando máquinas e motores, engraxando transducers e acoplamento da bomba da máquina do leme e limpando acessórios e equipamentos. Limpa caixão de ar de lavagem e válvula de suflação. Conserva pintura da praça de máquinas. Descarboniza motores. Esgota dalas, ralos e pocetos. Realiza manutenção de válvulas hidrostáticas e tiradores;

Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Experiência prévia na operação de máquinas.
  • Conhecimento básico em manutenção de equipamentos.
  • Capacidade de seguir instruções e trabalhar em equipe.
  • Atenção aos detalhes e comprometimento com a qualidade do trabalho.
  • Disponibilidade para cumprir escalas de trabalho flexíveis.

title: SUPERVISOR DE VENDAS
description:
VEM SER GUARACAMP!

Há 29 anos, nascemos na Zona Oeste do Rio como uma marcaraiz , autêntica como o carioca. Somos o Guaraná Natural mais amado do Rio de Janeiro , e temos orgulho da nossa história de crescimento com os pés no chão, foco em resultado e paixão pelo que fazemos.

Aqui, a gente tem Sangue Verde — orgulho de pertencer e atitude de dono. Cuidamos da empresa como se fosse nossa, percebemos o que precisa ser feito e agimos com senso de urgência.

Fazemos o que tem que ser feito , sem desculpas. Somos gente que arregaça as mangas, vai pra cima e entrega resultado.

Transparência é Lei : jogamos limpo, falamos com clareza e resolvemos as coisas com verdade e respeito.

Acreditamos que Tudo pode ser feito melhor — nada é definitivo, e evoluir é parte da nossa essência.

E, claro, Fazemos mais com menos : valorizamos cada recurso, buscamos eficiência e mantemos a qualidade em tudo que fazemos.

A Guaracamp Disponibiliza vagas para pessoas com Deficiência, conforme Art. 93, Lei 8.213/91 e art. 3º e 4º Dec.3.298-99.

OBJETIVO DO CARGO:

Liderar a equipe de vendas externas, promovendo estratégias para o aumento do volume de vendas e o fortalecimento da presença comercial. Garantir a execução eficaz de estratégias comerciais e a excelência no atendimento ao cliente. O Supervisor de Vendas deve atuar como um facilitador no desenvolvimento da equipe, impulsionar o crescimento dos resultados e manter um forte alinhamento com os objetivos organizacionais.

RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Liderar equipe de vendas, estabelecendo metas individuais e coletivas, monitorando o desempenho e promovendo ações de meloria contínua.
  • Acompanhar, planejar e direcionar os vendedores em suas rotinas externas.
  • Analisar indicadores de desempenho de vendas, identificar gargalos e propor soluções para aprimorar resultados.
  • Supervisonar a execução do processo de vendas pelos vendedores, garantindo que estejam alinhados aos padrões estabelecidos pela empresa.
  • Realizar reuniões matinais com a equipe para desdobrar objetivos, compartilhar resultados e motivar o time.
  • Rotina de rota, conhecendo os principais clientes da mesa.

REQUISITOS:

  1. Superior completo em Administração, gestão comercial ou áreas correlatas.
  2. Experiência anterior como supervisor de vendas.
  3. Desejável experiência no segmento de bens de consumo, principalmente bebidas.
  4. Pacote Office intermediário.
  5. CNH B.

HABILIDADES COMPORTAMENTAIS:

  1. Liderança
  2. Planejamento e organização
  3. Orientação para resultados
  4. Bom relacionamento interpessoal
